english.title: Secretary / officer of insurance company fail to allow officer appointed by Fire Commissioner to inspect books etc
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being

(A)_[the secretary]_
(B)_[an officer having the custody of the books and papers]_

of **(..SPECIFY INSURANCE COMPANY..), an insurance company that was required to pay a contribution to the London Fire Commissioner in pursuance of the Metropolitan Fire Brigade Act 1865, failed to allow **(..SPECIFY OFFICER..), an officer appointed by the Commissioner, to

(C)_[inspect, during the hours of business, books and papers that would enable him to ascertain the amount of property insured by the company in the Metropolis, and the amount for which it was insured]_
(D)_[inspect, during the hours of business, books and papers that would enable her to ascertain the amount of property insured by the company in the Metropolis, and the amount for which it was insured]_
(E)_[make extracts from books and papers that would enable him to ascertain the amount of property insured by the company in the Metropolis, and the amount for which it was insured]_
(F)_[make extracts from books and papers that would enable her to ascertain the amount of property insured by the company in the Metropolis, and the amount for which it was insured]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 17 of the Metropolitan Fire Brigade Act 1865.
